notes.title: New day changing alert added
notes.content:
A big and clear alert now appears when the day changes. 
Some people complained that it wasn't clear enough when the day changed so I hope this will make the game more clear about it's mechanics.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35026022/83c6beb48cb5bdfcf185e4e9900ac795b051e16c.png[/img]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
Rachel's house stairs have been replaced with a window.


[b]Thank you all for your feedback![/b]
